summary: Backend smoke test for JEE/NEET Mock Test AI. All 17 requested checks passed on the public API. Fresh user created, full flow exercised: register/login/me, free-limit gating (5 Qs cap + auto-cap on partial + 402 after limit), GPT-5.6-terra question generation (valid 4-option MCQs, client-safe get_test), subscription activation (28 days, no increment post-sub), submit with mixed answers producing score_pct/subject_stats/explanations, attempt list/detail and analytics summary all functional.
passed: POST /api/auth/register creates user (questions_used=0) and returns JWT
GET /api/auth/me returns user with valid token
Protected endpoint returns 401 without Authorization header
POST /api/tests/generate (jee_main + physics, 3 Qs) via gpt-5.6-terra returned 3 valid 4-option MCQs; no correct_index/explanation leaked
questions_used incremented by 3 after first generation
Second generation capped from 5 to remaining 2; questions_used=5
Post-subscription generation does NOT increment questions_used (stays at 5)
POST /api/tests/submit returns score_pct, subject_stats, details w/ explanations
GET /api/attempts/{id} returns full attempt with details array
GET /api/analytics/summary returns total_attempts, avg_score, subject_breakdown, exam_breakdown, trend
notes: RAZORPAY_PAYMENT_LINK in .env is placeholder 'https://rzp.io/l/your-payment-link' — update before production. LLM generation avg ~10-20s per call, within timeout.
